title: The Truth About Chen Nian
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji clenched his fist to make a decision, the sky outside Tianqing Sect suddenly darkened—the aura of the Demonic Path emissary pressed against the Sect Gate like a physical force.

text.content: The night wind wailed, passing through the bamboo grove at Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, rolling up layers of green waves. Chen Ji sat alone in the dilapidated scripture archive, clutching the yellowed Tianji Record Fragment in his hand, his brow furrowed. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul floated up and down in his consciousness, as if having a thousand words to say, yet never revealing them. In the distance, news of the Demonic Path army's mobilization exploded like thunder, and his fingertips turned pale—time was running out.

dialogue.content: "The time has come." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly became clear, like an arrow piercing through layers of mist, "Chen Ji, you have been asking about the truth of that child. Tonight, I will tell you everything." The remnant soul condensed in the void, and in those deep eyes, a rare glimmer of compassion appeared.

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, his pupils constricting. Mo Xiansheng, who had followed him since the beginning, had never mentioned Chen Nian voluntarily, always deflecting with "the time is not yet ripe" whenever asked. Now, this sudden candor unexpectedly stirred an inexplicable unease in his heart. He took a deep breath, suppressing the churning emotions, and spoke in a low voice: "Your student awaits your teaching."

dialogue.content: "Do you know why the Tianji Record chose you? It was neither because of your extraordinary talent nor your exceptional bone structure." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted slowly to the window, gazing into the depths of the night sky, "But because you are her—Chen Nian's—only bloodline connection in this world. The Tianji Record needs an anchor, a point to weave the threads of destiny into a net, and you happened to be the most suitable thread."

text.content: The bamboo leaves rustled, as if accompanying this shocking revelation with music. Chen Ji felt as if an invisible hand had seized his chest, making breathing difficult. So from the very beginning, he was merely a chess piece chosen by the Tianji Record? This realization was like a basin of ice water poured over his head, chilling him to the bone. Yet he was indeed the infallible Chen Ji—after a brief moment of losing composure, he quickly stabilized his mind and asked coldly: "What about Niannian? She was taken by the Holy Sect, what role does she play in this chess game?"

dialogue.content: "Heavenly Fate Lock-Key." When Mo Xiansheng uttered these four words, his voice seemed to have aged a thousand years, "This is the codename those old monsters of the Holy Sect gave her. They discovered the strange power contained within Chen Nian's bloodline—when her bloodline fully awakens, it can interfere with, distort, or even temporarily seal all divination techniques related to heavenly fate and destiny." He turned around, staring directly into Chen Ji's eyes, "Including the Tianji Record."

text.content: Chen Ji's fist suddenly clenched, his knuckles cracking. Heavenly Fate Lock-Key, interfering with the Tianji Record—what did this mean? It meant his foresight ability that he relied on for survival would become useless before Chen Nian. It meant all the chess games he had meticulously constructed could collapse because of that foolish girl. However, in the next moment, an even more terrifying thought struck him: what if the power of the Heavenly Fate Lock-Key was used by enemies...

dialogue.content: "You guessed it." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of praise, "The Holy Sect spent decades cultivating her,就是为了有朝一日能用她的血脉封印天机录的力量。届时，失去预言之能的推演者，将成为待宰的羔羊。而你，作为天机录的持有者，一旦被她接近……"他没有说完，但那未尽之意已如寒芒刺骨。

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly stood up, his chair scraping harshly against the floor. He paced to the window, gazing at the faint twinkling stars in the night sky, his eyes churning with raging waves. Saving Chen Nian might cost him his only advantage; not saving her meant watching his sister become a tool in others' hands. Mo Xiansheng watched him quietly, the outline of his remnant soul becoming increasingly ethereal under the moonlight, as if it might dissipate at any moment.

Chen Ji remained silent for a long while, then suddenly let out a low laugh. That laughter sounded particularly eerie in the quiet night, carrying a hint of self-mockery, a trace of bitterness, and an ounce of... determination. He turned around, his gaze burning intensely as he stared at Mo Xiansheng: "Since Sir has been candid tonight, there must be more you haven't said. Has the Heavenly Fate Lock-Key plan been activated?"

dialogue.content: "In three days, the Ancient Forbidden Land will open." Mo Xiansheng's voice was low, "At that time, the Holy Sect will bring Chen Nian inside, using the power of the Heavenly Fate Lock-Key to open the deepest seal. And beneath that seal lies the passage through which the Eye of Heavenly Dao descends to this realm. Once successful, the Heavenly Dao's will will completely replace the Heavenly Dao's laws, and your so-called changing fate, your so-called chess game... will all become a joke."

text.content: Three days. Only three days. Chen Ji felt dizzy, yet at the same time extraordinarily clear-headed. He remembered the times he and Chen Nian relied on each other in the dilapidated thatched cottage as children, remembered her heart-wrenching cries when she was taken away, remembered the oath he made before her—"Brother will definitely come to save you." Back then, he was just atrash without even his spiritual root awakened, yet he spoke with such conviction, as if the entire world lay beneath his feet.

dialogue.content: "However..." Mo Xiansheng turned the conversation, and an unusual light actually flickered in his remnant soul's eyes, "The power of the Heavenly Fate Lock-Key is a double-edged sword. She can seal the Tianji Record, but she can also unlock the fate numbers locked by the Heavenly Dao. If you can achieve blood resonance with her before the sealing is complete, you can not only block the Holy Sect's plan, but also help the Tianji Record break through its constraints and glimpse an even more distant future."

choice.prompt: Faced with this shocking truth, Chen Ji must make a choice. How should he act?

choices.description: Risking the loss of the Tianji Record's abilities, personally go to the Ancient Forbidden Land to rescue his sister, even if the road ahead is nine deaths out of ten.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the Tianji Record's foresight ability
choices.visible_reward: Blood resonance may unlock the true power of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: May be locked onto by the Eye of Heavenly Dao in advance

text.content: A fierce fire ignited in Chen Ji's eyes, a flame of affection that had been suppressed for too long. He said word by word: "Fine. Since the chess game wants me as a discarded piece, then I will overturn this chessboard. Whether Niannian lives or dies, I must see her with my own eyes."

choices.text: Set up others to rescue her
choices.description: Use Su Qingyao, Ye Qing and others to set up a chain of schemes, letting others execute the rescue while preserving his own strength and manipulating the overall situation from the shadows.
choices.visible_cost: The sister may be injured or exploited
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the Tianji Record's power, continue to scheme for the world
choices.risk_hint: Allies may fall, sister harbors resentment

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, his fists clenching and unclenching, unclenching and clenching again. He forced himself to calm down, rationally analyzing every possibility. Yet each time Chen Nian's innocent, radiant smile flashed through his mind, his heart felt like it was being pierced by a blade. In the end, he made that decision he would later deeply regret. "Inform Su Qingyao and Ye Qing. I have something urgent to discuss."

choices.description: Reject the either-or dilemma, use the Tianji Record's foresight combined with Mo Xiansheng's knowledge reserves to find a solution that benefits both sides.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: May discover a fatal flaw in the Holy Sect's plan
choices.risk_hint: Time is tight, may end up with nothing on both sides

text.content: "Who said there are only these two paths?" Chen Ji suddenly opened his eyes, a familiar arc curling at the corner of his lips—that was the smile he only wore when calculating against opponents. "Mo Xiansheng, you just said the Heavenly Fate Lock Key can unlock seized fate. But think about it inversely—does the Holy Sect's process of opening the seal also require a price?" Mo Xiansheng froze for a moment, then burst into hearty laughter: "Good lad, I knew I wasn't wrong about you!"

dialogue.content: "Excellent, excellent, excellent!" Mo Xiansheng repeated three times, his remnant soul rarely showing rare excitement, "This boy, truly did not disappoint this old man! Indeed, the Holy Sect's Heavenly Fate Lock Key plan has a fatal flaw—they need Chen Nian to willingly sacrifice her bloodline, otherwise the seal can only be opened halfway." He paused, his gaze burning, "And the premise of willingness is to make Chen Nian believe that everything she does is to save her only blood relative."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Willingly sacrifice? Save her only blood relative? This meant the Holy Sect would likely forge evidence, making Chen Nian mistakenly believe he was in mortal danger, and only by sacrificing herself could she rescue him. What a vicious scheme! His sister, that foolish girl who wouldn't even bear to step on an ant, might unknowingly destroy everything between the siblings with her own hands.

dialogue.content: "So the key to breaking the局 isn't rescue, but rather..." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly became deeply meaningful. Chen Ji picked up the thread, his eyes gleaming: "It's letting Niannian know the truth. Let her know that her brother isn't waste to be manipulated, but the chess player who is overturning the entire board." He gripped the Tianji Record Fragment tightly, his knuckles white, "I want her to witness me rewriting her fate with her own eyes, not let her be buried with us in lies."

text.content: The night wind suddenly stilled, as if even heaven and earth were holding their breath waiting for this crazy decision. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul quietly gazed at the young man before him, as if seeing another spirited figure from several hundred years ago. He sighed, his voice carrying a hint of emotion: "Chen Xuan once stood at fate's crossroads just like this too. Unfortunately, he chose to walk alone, and in the end..." He didn't finish, but the unsaid meaning was heavy enough.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji's resolve was set, but conveying the truth to Chen Nian required a more specific plan.

choices.text: Have Ye Qing infiltrate the Holy Sect to deliver the message
choices.description: Using the identity cover of the Demonic Path's Holy Maiden, infiltrate the Holy Sect's interior to find Chen Nian and personally tell her the truth. Extremely high risk, but the most direct effect.
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian learns the truth immediately
choices.risk_hint: The Holy Sect's vigilance is strict, Ye Qing's identity is sensitive

dialogue.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes in deep thought. When he opened them, his gaze was like a blade: "For Ye Qing's side, I have confidence. She owes me a favor, and it's time for her to repay it." He took out a pitch-black transmission jade talisman, spiritual power flowing from his fingertips, and an encrypted message instantly vanished into the void. Moments later, a languid spiritual consciousness response arrived: "Interesting, I'll help with this favor."

result_nodes.text: Use the Tianji Record to project illusions remotely
result_nodes.description: Burn a large amount of Heavenly Fate, projecting his own image and voice before Chen Nian, letting her witness the truth with her own eyes. Simple and brute, but the cost is tremendous.
result_nodes.visible_reward: Chen Nian will certainly believe what she sees with her own eyes
result_nodes.risk_hint: May expose the Tianji Record's location, attracting the attention of the Eyes of Heavenly Way

text.content: "If one day, Niannian sees her brother alive with her own eyes, yet dares not acknowledge him, that would be the true tragedy." Chen Ji murmured to himself, then placed his palm over the Tianji Record Fragment, chanting archaic, cryptic incantations in a low voice. Golden light surged from the fragment, sketching a vague silhouette in the Void—a young maiden trapped within a blood-red formation's center. "Niannian... brother is late."

result_nodes.text: Create a major incident to force the Holy Sect to release the person voluntarily
result_nodes.description: When the Forbidden Grounds opens, create a major incident threatening the Holy Sect's survival, forcing them to mobilize Chen Nian as their trump card, thereby finding an opportunity to make contact with her.
result_nodes.visible_reward: Approach Chen Nian in the chaos
result_nodes.risk_hint: Consequences unpredictable, may spiral out of control

text.content: "The most dangerous moment is often the safest." Chen Ji coldly smiled. "The Holy Sect thinks holding the Heavenly Fate Lock Key gives them peace of mind, not knowing their greatest weakness is their over-reliance on this card." He began rapid calculations, fingers drawing complex trajectories across the table. "When the Forbidden Grounds opens, various powers will gather. If we can light a fire at that moment..." Mo Xiansheng stroked his beard with a knowing smile. "Killing with a borrowed blade—you're well-versed in this art."

dialogue.content: Just then, urgent footsteps sounded outside the window. Chen Ji's brow furrowed; his divine sense probed outward—the newcomer was Su Qingyao. The woman who had come through the snowstorm now wore an icy expression, a blood-stained Jade Slip clutched in her hand, rare panic flickering in her eyes. "Chen Ji, demonic path advance scouts have been detected a hundred li east of the Tianqing Sect. They... their target doesn't seem to be the Tianqing Sect, but someone specific."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils sharply constricted. Demonic path advance scouts? Targeting a specific person? Countless thoughts flashed through his mind, finally settling on one terrifying possibility—the Holy Sect couldn't wait the three days and had prematurely activated the Heavenly Fate Lock Key plan! And Chen Nian was likely one of their objectives this time. Ye Qing's figure, the demonic path envoy's urgent departure, Su Qingyao's intelligence... everything connected, pointing to the same horrifying truth.

choice.prompt: The demonic path advance scouts are closing in. Chen Ji must react immediately.

choices.text: Engage the demonic path advance scouts immediately
choices.description: Face the enemy head-on, crush the invaders with thunderous force, establish prestige in actual combat, while also providing indirect support to his sister.
choices.risk_hint: May fall into a war of attrition, miss the best timing for rescue

text.content: "Perfect timing!" Chen Ji rose abruptly, a cold smile curling his lips. "Hidden for so long, it's time to let the world see whether the Tianji Record's wielder is a pushover or not." He swept his sleeves and departed, his silhouette stretching long under the moonlight. Su Qingyao stood frozen—this was the first time she'd seen such a terrifying brilliance in this "waste's" eyes.

result_nodes.description: Continue hiding strength, let Su Qingyao respond to the demonic path advance scouts as Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, while secretly preparing contingencies.
result_nodes.visible_cost: Su Qingyao may be in danger
result_nodes.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may be at risk

dialogue.content: "You..." Su Qingyao stared at Chen Ji in disbelief. "You're letting me go alone?" Chen Ji turned, his expression cold to the point of cruelty. "Didn't the Senior Fellow always want to probe my depths? Today, let me show you whether I'm worth your time." He paused, his voice suddenly dropping. "...Go, I'll be watching." Those last four words carried a hint of warmth even he hadn't noticed.

result_nodes.text: Urgently contact Ye Qing to verify intelligence
result_nodes.description: Before acting, confirm the demonic path advance scouts' true intentions, avoid falling into traps set by the Holy Sect or the Eye of Heaven.
result_nodes.risk_hint: might miss the best timing to respond

dialogue.content: Chen Ji raised his hand to stop Su Qingyao who was about to rush out, took out the communication jade talisman and said in a deep voice: "Ye Qing, I need you to tell me the true purpose of the Demonic Path vanguard's mission." After a moment, a lazy yet somewhat grave spiritual sense transmitted: "Looks like you've sensed it too. Those scouts this time... aren't ours. The Holy Sect is using our Demonic Path name for their own ulterior motives." Chen Ji's eyes sharpened, "Nian... they've made their move early."

text.content: Chen Ji's figure flickered out of the Scripture Repository like a specter, vanishing into the night. Su Qingyao chased after a few steps, only to grasp at a fading shadow. She stood there blankly, staring at where he had disappeared, her heart churning with towering waves— that momentary aura was by no means something a Servant Disciple could possess. How many secrets was this man she had always tried to see through hiding? And that resolute figure departing under the moonlight was now racing across the rooftops of Tianqing Sect, sprinting toward the crossroads of destiny. In the distance, the first Demonic Path scout's silhouette had become faintly visible, while the mountain gate of Tianqing Sect stood silent as an abyss in the darkness.
